Introduction

This Privacy Policy explains how Digital Exhibition collects, uses, stores and protects information when visitors use our website. We are committed to respecting the privacy of our visitors and handling personal information responsibly. This policy also explains the choices available to users regarding their personal information.

1. Data We Collect

1.1 Information You Provide

We may collect personal information that you voluntarily provide when interacting with the Digital Exhibition, such as your name, email address and any information submitted through enquiry or contact forms.

1.2 Information Collected Automatically

When you access the Digital Exhibition, certain technical information may be collected automatically, such as your browser type, device type, IP address and general website usage information. This information may be used to maintain, secure and improve the website.

2. How We Use Your Data

2.1 Providing and Maintaining the Website

We may use collected information to operate, maintain and improve the Digital Exhibition, provide access to exhibition content, respond to enquiries and ensure that website features function correctly.

2.2 Improving User Experience and Security

We may use technical and usage information to understand how visitors interact with the Digital Exhibition, improve accessibility and user experience, identify technical problems and help protect the website from misuse or security threats.

3. How We Share Information

3.1 Service Providers

We may share limited information with trusted service providers that support the operation, hosting, maintenance or security of the Digital Exhibition. These providers should only use information as necessary to provide their services.

3.2 Legal Requirements

We may disclose information when required by law or when reasonably necessary to protect the rights, safety and security of the Digital Exhibition, its users or others. We do not sell visitors' personal information.

4. Your Choices and Obligations

4.1 Your Privacy Choices

You may choose not to provide personal information unless it is required for a particular website feature. You may also contact us to ask about personal information you have provided and request that inaccurate information be corrected where appropriate.

4.2 Responsible Use

Visitors are expected to use the Digital Exhibition responsibly and must not attempt to misuse the website, interfere with its operation or access information or systems without authorisation.

5. Other Important Information

5.1 Data Security

We take reasonable measures to protect information associated with the Digital Exhibition from unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure or loss. However, no method of transmitting or storing information online can guarantee complete security.

5.2 Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy when the Digital Exhibition, its features or privacy practices change. Any updated version will be published on this page, and visitors are encouraged to review the policy periodically.

5.3 Contact Us

If you have questions, concerns or requests relating to this Privacy Policy or the handling of your information, please contact the Digital Exhibition team using the enquiry or contact options provided on the website.
